rationale: Promoted the source-visible consequence of an empty reconstruction on the vote path as durable behaviour knowledge, citing the guards themselves: both requestVote and requestPreVote guard their membership and voter rejections behind len(configurations.latest.Servers) > 0, so a node whose reconstruction is empty performs no membership or voter check when it decides whether to grant support.

knowledge.statement: With an empty reconstructed configuration both vote handlers skip their membership and voter rejections: requestVote rejects a candidate absent from the configuration only when len(r.configurations.latest.Servers) > 0 and rejects a candidate without a vote under the same guard, and requestPreVote repeats both guards, so a node holding no servers performs neither check and can grant support to a peer that is neither a member nor a voter of the committed configuration.
knowledge.conditions: The node's configurations.latest is empty while the committed configuration recorded in its own log names members; the request passes the term, leader and log up-to-dateness checks that follow the guards; NewRaft reconstruction with RestoreCommittedLogs enabled can produce such an empty configuration at startup.
